purpose: Documents the exact upstream algorithms and immutable catalog snapshot used by src/weapon.py. This file is metadata; resources/provenance.json remains owned by the main runtime.

bundled_resources.note: Byte-for-byte upstream snapshot version=2 checked 2026-10-08: 29 base weapons plus supplemental epg1, sheila and snipers_mark. Only nemesis, alternator and car contain real-video edge icon prototypes (11 total); other weapons have text aliases only.

adapted_sources.note: Native HUD text normalization/resolution, active-slot/background selection, caption views, constrained CTC label repair and icon signatures.
Non-causal event weapon context: firing ammo-drop proof, held-at/before-event evidence, excluded view handling and weapon-icon masks.
Official catalog/alias source metadata. The generated catalog snapshot is bundled instead of downloading or rebuilding at runtime.
Shoot-event annotation thresholds, learned/local prototype margin rules and the explicit prohibition against treating held weapon context as kill attribution.

runtime_models.note: Existing bundled RapidOCR recognition model reused lazily by WeaponReader. Upstream referenced a PP-OCRv5 mobile model, but that source repository did not include it; no model is newly bundled or downloaded.

safety: No original video or resource file is modified.
The catalog is loaded read-only and verified against CATALOG_SHA256 in src/weapon.py.
Learning writes only output_dir/learned-weapons.json when save_learning() is explicitly called; pending samples are not active in the same reader.
Learned samples are accepted only for catalog-known weapon IDs/variants. OCR text that resolves to no catalog weapon cannot invent a new weapon identity.
